name: s3-sidekick
description: A Cross-Platform Desktop client for S3-compatible Object Storage.

scripts.test:e2e:scripts: npm run test:e2e:sync-version && npm run test:e2e:tauri-alignment && npm run test:e2e:clean-tree
scripts.test:all: node scripts/test-all.js && npm run test:release-assets && npm run icons:check && node scripts/finalize-quality-gate.js
scripts.release:supply-chain: npm run setup:cargo-audit && npm audit --audit-level=high --ignore-scripts && npm audit signatures && npm run audit:cargo && npm run licenses
scripts.lint: eslint src/ scripts/ playwright.config.ts tests/browser/ && npm run lint:comments
scripts.licenses: npm run licenses:npm && npm run licenses:cargo
scripts.tauri:dev: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json
scripts.tauri:build: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && tauri build -- --locked
scripts.b: node scripts/require-clean-tree.mjs && git fetch origin && git reset --hard && git clean -fd && git switch -C beta origin/beta && git reset --hard origin/beta && git clean -fd && npm run vi
scripts.r: node scripts/require-clean-tree.mjs && git fetch origin && git reset --hard && git clean -fd && git switch -C main origin/main && git reset --hard origin/main && git clean -fd && npm run vi && npm run gitprune:force
scripts.u: npm run sync-version && node scripts/npm-safe-update.mjs && node scripts/cargo-safe-update.mjs --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && npm run check:tauri-alignment
scripts.win-compiler:arm64: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -NoExit -Command "& 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\Common7\Tools\Launch-VsDevShell.ps1' -SkipAutomaticLocation -Arch arm64 -HostArch amd64"
scripts.setup:win:release: npm run setup:win:artifact-signing && npm run setup:win:7zip
scripts.build:win:x64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:win:x64:prepared
scripts.build:win:arm64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:win:arm64:prepared
scripts.build:win: npm run build:win:x64 && npm run build:win:arm64
scripts.build:mac:dev: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run icons:normalize && dotenv -e .env -- tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles app --no-sign -- --locked
scripts.build:mac:universal: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run icons:normalize && npm run build:mac:universal:prepared
scripts.build:linux:x64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:linux:x64:prepared
scripts.build:linux:arm64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:linux:arm64:prepared
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:linux:x64 && npm run build:linux:arm64
scripts.release:prepare: npm run workspace:bootstrap && npm run test:all -- --require-clean-proof --skip-e2e && npm run release:supply-chain && npm run dist:clean-release-artifacts && npm run release:session:start
scripts.release:finalize: npm run release:mirror && npm run release:cleanup:checkout
scripts.release:cleanup:checkout: git fetch origin && git reset --hard @{u} && git clean -fd
scripts.release:mac:ssh: npm run mac:ssh:keychain && node scripts/run-release.js mac
scripts.setup:deb: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y build-essential curl wget file libgtk-3-dev libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libjavascriptcoregtk-4.1-dev libsoup-3.0-dev libglib2.0-dev libssl-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev libxdo-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf rpm flatpak flatpak-builder && sudo flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists flathub https://flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo && rustup toolchain install 1.98.0 --profile minimal && rustup default 1.98.0
scripts.setup:flatpak: sudo flatpak install -y flathub org.gnome.Platform//49 org.gnome.Sdk//49 org.freedesktop.Sdk.Extension.node24//25.08 org.freedesktop.Sdk.Extension.rust-stable//25.08
scripts.build:win:prepared: npm run build:win:x64:prepared && npm run build:win:arm64:prepared
scripts.build:linux:prepared: npm run build:linux:x64:prepared && npm run build:linux:arm64:prepared
scripts.workspace:bootstrap: npm run rust:update && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run sync-version
scripts.workspace:prepare: npm run workspace:bootstrap && npm run test:all
scripts.release:win:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:draft && npm run rust:targets:win && npm run build:win:prepared && npm run release:sign:updater && npm run release:sign:gpg && npm run release:finalize
scripts.release:win:resume: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:win:continue
scripts.release:mac:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:wait-draft && npm run rust:targets:mac && npm run build:mac:universal:prepared && npm run build:mac:zip && npm run release:sign:gpg && npm run release:finalize
scripts.release:mac:resume: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:mac:continue
scripts.release:mac:ssh:resume: npm run mac:ssh:keychain && npm run release:mac:resume
scripts.release:linux:x64:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:wait-draft && npm run rust:target:linux:x64 && npm run build:linux:x64:prepared && npm run flatpak:clean && npm run flatpak:bundle && npm run release:sign:gpg && npm run release:finalize
scripts.release:linux:x64:resume: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:linux:x64:continue
